            if (paddle.x + paddle.width > canvas.width) paddle.x = canvas.width - paddle.width;

                }

                // Remove if off screen
                if (obj.y > canvas.height) {
                    fallingObjects.splice(index, 1);
                }
            });

            // Draw score
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.font = '20px Arial';
            ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);

            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }

        // Spawn objects periodically
        setInterval(createObject, spawnInterval);

        // Start game loop
        gameLoop();

How it plays

rules of the conveyor

01
Chain for multiplierEvery five catches in a row raises your multiplier by ×1, up to ×5. A single spike or drop resets it to ×1.
02
The belt speeds upA new level every 20 seconds: faster falls, tighter gaps, a slightly narrower crate.
03
Spikes get greedyThe higher the level, the more often spikes appear among the good shapes. Watch the silhouette.
04
Three lives, no refundsDropping a good shape and catching a bad one cost the same. Score is banked instantly.
